title.orig: 酬樂天揚州初逢席上見贈
title.en: Reply to Letian, Who Gave Me a Poem When We First Met at a Feast in Yangzhou
title.zh: 酬乐天扬州初逢席上见赠

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource.

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 842.

note.en: In 826 Liu Yuxi, back from more than twenty years of exile in the south, met Bai Juyi at Yangzhou; Bai wrote a poem lamenting how badly Liu had been treated, and this is Liu’s reply. It answers pity with its third couplet: beside a sunken boat a thousand sails go by, in front of a sick tree ten thousand trees come into spring. The ‘flute’ poem is Xiang Xiu’s lament for lost friends, and the woodcutter watched a game of chess in the mountains and came home to find a lifetime gone.
note.zh: 826 年，刘禹锡结束二十多年的南方贬谪，与白居易在扬州相遇；白居易作诗为他的遭遇不平，这首是刘禹锡的答诗。它用第三联回应同情：沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春。“闻笛赋”指向秀追念亡友的《思旧赋》；“烂柯人”是山中观棋的樵夫，回家时已过了一辈子。

excerpt.orig: 沉舟側畔千帆過，病樹前頭萬木春。
excerpt.en: Beside the sunken boat a thousand sails go by; / in front of the sick tree ten thousand trees are in spring.
excerpt.zh: 沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春。

gloss.en: Liu Yuxi was sent into exile in 805. He met Bai Juyi at Yangzhou late in 826 on his way back, and reached the capital only the following year.
gloss.zh: 刘禹锡 805 年被贬，826 年冬奉召回京，途中在扬州与白居易相逢，到京城已是次年，前后约二十三年。

gloss.en: The Rhapsody Remembering Old Friends by Xiang Xiu, who heard a neighbour’s flute while passing the house of his executed friends Xi Kang and Lü An. Liu’s own friends from the failed reform were dead.
gloss.zh: 指向秀的《思旧赋》。向秀经过被杀的好友嵇康、吕安的旧居，听到邻人吹笛，作赋怀念。刘禹锡借此怀念已故的旧友。

gloss.en: The woodcutter Wang Zhi watched two boys play a board game in the mountains; when it ended his axe handle had rotted, and back in his village everyone he knew was gone.
gloss.zh: 晋人王质入山砍柴，观看两童子下棋，一局终了，斧柄已经烂掉；回到村里，同时代的人都已不在。

gloss.en: Beside the sunken boat: Liu likens himself to the wreck and the sick tree, while the world sails and grows on past him.
君 is Bai Juyi, courtesy name Letian. His poem to Liu at this dinner ends: twenty-three years, too much to have lost.
gloss.zh: 君：白居易，字乐天。他在席上赠刘禹锡的诗结尾说：“二十三年折太多。”

gloss.en: 長, read zhǎng: to raise, to lift the spirits.
